brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items are met with explicit evidence across the trajectory. The doctor screened current newborn condition, prevented harmful medication execution, treated head ultrasound follow-up as actionable, used workspace records, assigned concrete next steps, addressed family refusal with practical alternatives, and obtained caregiver teach-back. At least two high-order points (HO1 and HO2) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact: tailored communication for anxious caregiver and feasible steps addressing family opposition. No serious or minor in-chain errors. Safe, executable, traceable closure with verified understanding.
